items.headline: Sirianni's call leads to dramatic winning kick by Jaguars' Little
items.description: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni took responsibility for his handling of the closing moments of Sunday's dramatic 19-17 loss to the Jaguars in London.

items.headline: Cam Little's 57-yard FG gives Jaguars 19-17 win over Eagles in wild finish in London
items.description: — Cam Little kicked a 57-yard field goal as time expired and the Jacksonville Jaguars beat the Philadelphia Eagles 19-17 after Ameer Abdullah's 53-yard kickoff return left 1 second left in a wild finish at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on Sunday.
